scientific_integrity: The infinite claim is proved symbolically. The finite checker is only a regression test against the source table for k=2..9 and is not used to infer the all-k theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves Benfield--Lippard Conjecture 10.4 only. It gives structural transfer formulas to an auxiliary numerical semigroup but does not provide closed forms for its Frobenius number or genus, and it does not settle the neighboring conjectures in Section 10.
title: A two-adic semigroup decomposition proves the parity conjecture for stable Waring exceptions
